claims.claim: typed graph state can be causally audited
claims.unmeasured: learned parser dependence on the graph
claims.invalidate_if: raw-prompt or unused-field intervention changes output while typed state is fixed

claims.claim: explicit identity can preserve bindings and literals
claims.unmeasured: identity recall on real long-context code
claims.invalidate_if: identity recall falls below declared context target or uses an opaque residual path

claims.claim: typed modules support systematic novel composition
claims.unmeasured: learned semantic routing and real repository APIs
claims.invalidate_if: grouped, contamination-free held-out compositions do not exceed whole-program retrieval

claims.claim: runtime receipts and proofs are replayable
claims.unmeasured: compiler integration and adversarial real programs
claims.invalidate_if: replay misses a changed operation, proof cycle, effect leak, or schedule divergence

claims.claim: a fully interpretable learned architecture fits under 40M
claims.invalidate_if: measured learned parameters exceed 40M or a raw bypass is required for parity

claims.unmeasured: all coding benchmark scores, latency, memory, and distribution definition
claims.invalidate_if: any parity statement is made before a preregistered grouped benchmark and resource comparison

required_next_gate: train one role-constrained configuration, run grouped metamorphic/coder evaluation, then apply no-bypass and resource gates
